title: Working line: the bot's mark and what it is doing now
evidence: Working line in Transcript.tsx + styles.css: row 180 ms, mark 340 ms spring, label 180 ms (+220 ms first), shimmer steps(60) 2.2 s, face squash and tilt, exit 140 ms. It starts with the mark alone, like the oracle, and comes with the bot's Working state (Barkpark's fleet stream): storage's row 0.8 s after "is working" matches (working#1; a row ignoring the state fails it, early by 776 ms; holding the line 300 ms longer fails it, late by 303 ms). What it is doing now: the bot's own summary of the turn (Barkpark #26296, event: runtime {kind: status, native: {label}}) as plain words, 60 at most, replayed at the oracle's label time: label:status#1 passes on all 4 turns, and the same event 300 ms late fails it on all 4; a tool call's name and input (Bash's description, else the tool; live --tool saw one); "Typing…" while text streams. "replied" lands with the reply bubble. A status after the text has started is ignored, so it never covers "Typing…" (behaviour). Caveat, Barkpark's side: live, the summary arrives 6-12 s after a send on the owner's Mac (the oracle's ~2.4 s), usually after the text has begun, so live turns mostly show no summary.
gate: Gate B 63/63 on 4 turns (oracle 0.79.3) on the recorded local runs (parity/gate-b/; the working-line exit 237.5-241.5 ms against its 250 ms budget): working#1, label:status#1, label:typing, status:replied and the exit budget. Hosted runs are report only: the last 5 main runs (2026-11-22, 3502794 to 743fc17) gave 60/63 each, each flipping the working-line exit budget in 3 of the 4 turns, 255-389 ms, on the runner's timer lateness, not the app; a single run varies (59-61/63 on PR runs) (ten green main runs 11-14 to 11-17: 251-397 ms; task-dca2017494aa727d). The budget stays 250 ms, judged on the local runs (lead's ruling, 2026-11-23); behaviour 2 status rules; live parity/live/tool.json (a tool label seen)
